chapter: Scrapbook: the Lewis band and New York
title: Photo of Child's Paramount in New York and the George Lewis Blue Note record
summary: Looking at scrapbook pictures of the George Lewis band at Child's Paramount in 1955, Guesnon explains that the Blue Note record was made in New Jersey and is his favorite.
